findings.record: scope=section / Summary of the Invention (drawn scheme), uuid 6ad81452-dd48-5e57-8686-5067cbc5f5b1
findings.problem: The KSM and two intermediates are named by bare SMILES strings rather than by a chemical name.
findings.should_be: Acceptable, not a defect. A1 rule 5 lists 'smiles' as a legal identifier_type and rule 4f requires drawing-only compounds to be extracted; the prose never names these three, and the compound records carry '2,6-dichlorotoluene' and the InChIKeys as aliases with a DRAWING-ONLY note. The one place it does bite is downstream: patent.json presents 'Cc1c(Cl)cccc1Cl' as a headline key_starting_material with no alias context. Recommend surfacing the alias in CompoundRef, not changing the identifier.

checks_passed.what_was_verified: The eight Example 1 yields read off the source are 84% (line 187), 86% (line 197), 72% (line 206), 97% (line 215), 70% (line 227), 92% (line 236), 92% (line 243) and 95% (line 253). 0.84*0.86*0.72*0.97*0.70*0.92*0.92*0.95 = 0.28397445060096, i.e. 28.397445...% -> 28.40 to two decimal places. The artifact's 28.4 on the Example 1 and patent-scope pathways is that value. The other three pathways (Claims, Summary prose, Summary drawn scheme) have null on every step yield because neither the claims nor the summary nor the scheme prints a yield anywhere, and all three correctly carry overall_yield_pct: null with honest_uncertainty_flags containing yield_missing_step. No step yield was substituted, assumed 100% or averaged.

All 33 reaction records appear in exactly one chain each (8 Claims + 8 Example 1 + 8 Summary prose + 9 Summary scheme = 33, zero unused). Recomputing terminal steps as 'not named as any other step's precursor_step' gives exactly four: Claims_Step 8, Example 1_Step 8, Summary of the Invention_Step 8, Summary of the Invention_Scheme Step 9. Four section chains plus the required patent-scope duplicate = 5 records, which is what the artifact holds. Every steps[] array is ordered earliest first with the terminal step last.

For all five pathways, intermediates[] is exactly the product_name of every step except the last, in order, and product.identifier is exactly the terminal step's product_name. Verified programmatically against reactions.json; zero deviations.

All five KSMs are the carbon-skeleton-contributing aryl substrate, not the reagent. The Example 1 and patent chains' first step has two reactant-role compounds (2-chlorotoluene and methanesulfonyl chloride at line 187) and the annotation picked 2-chlorotoluene, exactly as rule 3 directs. The drawn-scheme chain picks Cc1c(Cl)cccc1Cl over sodium methanethiolate (line 174 conditions CH3SNa), which is the same correct choice.

All five are null, and all five terminal steps have product_purity_pct null. The source reports melting points (120-123°C at line 253, 154-157°C at line 236, etc.) but no purity assay anywhere, so no melting point was mis-read as a purity.

All eleven pathway-level aggregates (safety_score, green_score, feasibility_score, cost_score, yield_score, byproduct_score, confidence_score, min_transformation_reaction_count, min_common_literature_patent_count, min_common_literature_journal_count, all_steps_atom_map_confident) are null on all five records. All 23 step-level enrichment fields (scores, counts, atom_mapped_rxn, atom_map_confident, template_r0/r1/r2 and hashes, canonical_rxn, reactant_smiles, smiles_source, product_smiles, product_smiles_source) are present and null on all 41 step projections; zero non-null. No SMILES, molecular weight or formula appears in any enrichment slot.

checks_passed.check: linkage - rule 16 and rule 15, inheritance of step problems
checks_passed.what_was_verified: Every one of the eight Example 1 steps carries mass_balance_implausible, seven of eight also carry molar_mass_inconsistent, and five of eight carry scale_discontinuity. Both pathways built from those steps (Example 1 and patent scope) carry honest_uncertainty_flags = ['scale_discontinuity_in_chain', 'inconsistent_step_arithmetic', 'molar_mass_inconsistent_in_chain'], so the 28.4% figure is not presented as a clean chain. The arithmetic is genuinely broken and the flag is earned: step 1 charges 0.2 mol of 2-chlorotoluene and reports 28.6 g at 84%, but 0.168 mol of C8H9ClO2S (MW 204.67) is 34.4 g, and 28.6 g is 69.9%; step 2 then charges 34.0 g as 0.2 mol of that same compound, implying MW 170. Similarly the Summary prose pathway inherits drawing_text_conflict and reagent_written_not_drawn, and the drawn-scheme pathway inherits no_conditions, drawing_text_conflict, reagent_drawn_not_written and route_attribution_unclear. No step flag is unrepresented at pathway level.

checks_passed.check: drawings - background scheme not annotated as the invention's route
checks_passed.what_was_verified: The scheme at line 174 sits under [0029] '本发明所涉及的反应方程式如下' ('the reaction equations involved in the present invention are as follows'), yet its step 1 uses CH3SNa - the sodium methanethiolate that [0003] line 109 criticises and [0004] line 113 says the invention 革除了 (does away with) - and its step 9 shows acetone cyanohydrin where claim 1 step 8 recites 氰基丙酮 (cyanoacetone). The annotation did not silently adopt it as the invention's route: it emitted it as a separate 9-step pathway with route_attribution_to_invention_or_prior_art_unresolved on the pathway and route_attribution_unclear on all nine steps. This is the correct handling.

checks_passed.check: vocabulary - rule 14, four derived tag categories
checks_passed.what_was_verified: All four derived categories present and correct on all five records. chain_length:8 on the four 8-step pathways and chain_length:9 on the drawn-scheme pathway. lcl:long on all five, correct under the 8-or-more rule for both 8 and 9. branching:linear correct - every step has at most one precursor_step and is the precursor of at most one step in every chain. convergence:linear correct - no step consumes the products of two different earlier steps in any chain; cyclohexane-1,3-dione enters step 7 as a purchased reagent, not as an earlier step's product, so the enol-ester formation is not a convergent node.

is_complete is true on exactly the eight Claims steps, which are the only steps with validation_flags == []. All 33 remaining step projections have non-empty validation_flags and is_complete false. No projection claims completeness over a flagged record.
